verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own pre-request and after-response scripts run automatically around request lifecycle events (before send, after response) and can perform actions such as manipulating environment variables, auth or request contents. That is an event-triggered action mechanism, but it is limited to the request lifecycle and is script-based rather than a general rules engine. Missing for 10: a general event/trigger rules engine beyond request send/response, declarative rule definition, other event sources (e.g., spec changes, sync events, schedules), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Pre-request scripts allow you to execute tasks before a request is sent. They can be used to: * Manipulate environment variables or authentication * Manipulate the contents of the request
Pre-request and after-response scripting to add logic to your requests
